name: skryensya-ui
description: Turborepo for skryensya/ui. Core contains tokens and the framework-agnostic component contract.

comment-overrides: The 8 entries below @types/node close the 20 advisories `pnpm audit` was reporting
(9 high, 10 moderate, 1 low). NONE is a direct dependency of this repo: all 8 come in from
underneath (astro, vite, jsdom, the MCP SDK), so there is no package.json to bump them in and an
override is the only place they can be reached from.
CARET AND NOT >=: ^ stays inside the major the tree already uses, which is exactly what makes
this safe to apply blindly over someone else's dependencies. Verified before writing it:
each of the 8 appears with ONE single major in the lockfile, so there is no consumer
expecting another line that forcing it would break.
The entry is deleted when the package above bumps on its own: an override that no longer changes
anything is a frozen old version waiting for someone to notice it.
